title: Abba Chalifa Kirvaya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Bava Batra 123a, he asked Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba a question. Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:1 teaches: “Abba bar Chalifai bar Karei: When does this apply? To produce definitely liable for tithes.” Rabbi Chiyya bar Wa was in Rome and saw them redeeming produce. He said: “The one who ruled for them was Chilfari bar Kirei” (possibly a place-name). In the old Midrash Tehillim, chapter 20, Rabban Gamliel (identified by Hyman as the son of Rabbi Yehudah the second Nasi) went to Abba Chalfa ben Kruyah to have him pray for him.

notes.text: The different Chalifai/Kirvaya/Kirei forms are preserved. The suggestion that the latter is a place-name is Hyman’s, not an identification made here.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:1 concerns redeeming produce and has Chilfai bar Kirvaya. Hyman’s possible place-name, the old Midrash Tehillim wording and the Nasi’s genealogy remain attributed claims.
